subject: Kickoff: org access, admin invites & API key seeding for NovaMed
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@novamed.com>, Mark Ellis <mark@novamed.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Oct 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: org access, admin invites & API key seeding for NovaMed

Hi Asha / Mark —

Thanks again for the signature — excited to get NovaMed into the platform. To keep the first-week activation smooth we want to lock the following items in this thread:

1) Admin invite list (who gets Owner/Admin in the initial workspace) — please use the attached CSV template and send us the completed list.
2) Service account/project for API traffic and a request for two long-lived API keys (one for Prod service account, one for CI/test).
3) Role matrix: which roles (Admin/Developer/ReadOnly) for the early team.
4) KMS note: if you want Redwood to encrypt keys with your KMS let us know KMS provider and IAM role.

Proposed timeline (target):
- Today (Oct 29): customer returns completed admin CSV
- Tomorrow (Oct 30): Redwood seeds service account, creates API keys, and shares secrets via secure channel
- Nov 3: first test calls and short smoke-run with your engineers

Attachments: admin_list_template.csv (CSV with columns: name, email, role, team, phone)

Action for you: please attach the completed CSV with the two people who should be initial Admins and any service account owner.

If you'd prefer, we can do a 20-minute screen share this afternoon to run through IAM and the invite flow.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
---
Redwood Inference | implementation@redwood.com
From: Asha Patel <asha@novamed.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Ellis <mark@novamed.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Oct 2025 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: org access, admin invites & API key seeding for NovaMed

Jordan / Monica —

Attached is the admin list (novamed_admins.csv). Quick notes:
- Priya Shah (priya.shah@novamed.com) should be the primary Admin (owner role).
- Mark Ellis (mark@novamed.com) should be Admin as backup.
- We need a dedicated service account for our integration (name: novamed-infer-svc). Please create two API keys: one labeled "novamed-prod" and one labeled "novamed-ci".
- For KMS: we will use AWS KMS (account id xxxxx). We do not require Redwood-managed KMS for the initial rollout; we will surface the IAM role next week.

We can do the 20-minute screen share at 4pm PT if that works for you.

Thanks — Asha
Asha Patel
Head of Analytics, NovaMed
Attachment: novamed_admins.csv
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha@novamed.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Oct 2025 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Kickoff: org access, admin invites & API key seeding for NovaMed

David / Monica —

Forwarding Asha's admin list. Can you take the provisioning items below?

Tasks (David):
- Create workspace/project "novamed-prod" and a service account "novamed-infer-svc".
- Generate two API keys scoped to the service account: tags: novamed-prod, novamed-ci. Preferable: rotateable keys and notes set with owner email priya.shah@novamed.com.
- If generating keys in the Console, export the secure sharing link and provide to Jordan (we'll use the secure channel).

Tasks (Monica):
- Send the invite flow for Priya and Mark (Admin) and confirm they receive the onboarding email.
- Validate the role mapping: Admin->Owner, Developer->Editor, ReadOnly->Viewer for NovaMed's setup.

Security notes: Asha indicated they will supply AWS KMS info later. For now create keys under Redwood-managed encryption but add a note for KMS owner transition. See attached tenant_spec.yaml for default quotas and sequence of steps.

Please update ETA in this thread.

—Jordan

Asha —

Thanks for the file and the quick turnaround. Confirmation and next steps: 

- David will provision the novamed-prod workspace and novamed-infer-svc service account today and seed the two API keys.
- Monica will send Admin invites to Priya and Mark immediately after provisioning. Expect invites within 2 hours of provisioning.
- I'll schedule the 20-minute screen share for 4pm PT today and will send a calendar invite.
- We'll deliver the secure secret share link in this thread once keys are generated. Keys will be marked for rotation and noted with owner's email.

If there are any changes to roles or additional people to include, reply-all with the updated CSV (please keep the format).
